title: Which feature is there?
description:
Use feature-test macros to report what your compiler and library support.

```
C++ version: 202002
__cpp_concepts: 202002
__cpp_lib_format: 202110
__cpp_lib_expected: not available
```
hints: Library features like `__cpp_lib_format` come from `<version>`; language ones like `__cpp_concepts` are built into the compiler (lesson 2.04).
A macro's value is the year and month the feature reached the standard, so newer values mean newer versions.
requirements: Print `__cplusplus` and at least six feature macros from the `<version>` header.
Use `#ifdef` so the program compiles where a feature is missing.
Look up one of them on cppreference's feature-test page and note what its value means.
stretch: Use `std::format` only when `__cpp_lib_format` is defined, and `printf` otherwise.
